Final-year PhD candidate · Computational Media and Arts

Actively seeking faculty positionsGet in touch ↗

Yushi is a final-year PhD candidate in Computational Media and Arts at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), advised by Hai-Ning Liang and Pan Hui. His research explores human perception and spatial interaction in extended reality (XR), seeking to expand what people can perceive, express, and accomplish across physical and digital worlds.
